milestones.label: Selection committee meets for the 2027 intake
milestones.source_text: The DAAD call text says a committee of professors from the participating master's courses and DAAD representatives selects candidates in October/November 2026. Read from a copy of the call hosted on a third-party site (the text is the DAAD's own).

milestones.label: Applicants informed of the selection outcome
milestones.source_text: The DAAD call text says all applicants are informed in writing after selection ends, expected in December 2026/January 2027. Read from a copy of the call hosted on a third-party site (the text is the DAAD's own). A university programme page gives roughly the end of December 2026.
